meta.name: canary-deployment
meta.description: Implement canary deployment strategies to gradually roll out new versions to subset of users with automatic rollback based on metrics.

copy.tagline: 逐步发布新版本并自动回滚
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在生产环境安全地发布新版本。
copy.tagline_en: Gradually roll out new versions with automatic rollback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to safely deploy new versions in production.

howto.what: 金丝雀部署技能让Claude帮你逐步将新版本先发布给一小部分用户，自动监控错误率，如果指标正常就继续扩大，否则自动回滚。
howto.when: 当你需要进行低风险的逐步发布、或在真实流量中测试新版本、或需要基于指标自动回滚时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置一个金丝雀部署，先给5%的用户。
say.note: Claude会生成或修改部署配置。

say.text: 设置错误率超过2%时自动回滚。
say.note: Claude会添加监控和回滚逻辑。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to implement canary deployment strategies: gradually roll out a new version to a small subset of users, monitor metrics, and automatically rollback or proceed based on predefined thresholds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need low-risk gradual rollouts, real-world testing with live traffic, or automated rollback based on metrics. Suitable for high-traffic services and A/B testing.

say_en.text: Set up a canary deployment with 5% traffic to the new version.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the deployment config.
Claude adds monitoring and rollback logic.
